description: Adjusts the LEVELS of silence-separated events - evening them out or imposing an accent pattern - without moving anything ('INFO: Extracting events envelope / INFO: Adjusting events loudness'). Duration genuinely static (sample-exact). Two régimes: with meter 0 (default), evening 0..1 scales how much event loudnesses are pulled toward equal - BUT this path has NO headroom management and boosts quiet events past full scale (verified: evening 1 on events at peak gains 1.0/0.3/0.6/0.15 drove output peaks to 1.0/3.35/1.43/6.45 - up to 6.4x over 0 dBFS in the float file, no warning). With meter N > 0, every Nth event (starting at the first) is accented and the others are scaled to exactly evening x the accent level (verified: meter 3, evening 0.3 -> unaccented peaks exactly 0.3x) - this path only attenuates and is clip-safe. The banner's second flag '[-mpregain]' is a typo for -p, and -p is a verified NO-OP in this mode (byte-identical at 0.1/0.5/default). Event detection = runs of >= minsil ms of EXACT digital zeros; no-silence material refuses 'NO SILENCE-GAPS FOUND IN FILE.' Deterministic; stereo accepted.
musical_use: The dynamics half of event surgery: after quantising with mode 4 or re-rhythmicising with 6/7, use meter to write the accent pattern - meter 3, evening 0.3 turns any even stream into a waltz (STRONG-weak-weak); meter 2 gives a backbeat feel; meter 4 marks bar lines. Evening mode (meter 0) at moderate values (0.3-0.6) tames wild level differences in a phrase so later granular/sorting processes see comparable events - but stage attenuation after it (see known_issues) because it normalises by loudness and will push short quiet events far past full scale at evening near 1. The two-pass combo mode 9 -> mode 10 (thin, then accent) gets drum-machine-like programming out of any event train.

minsil.description: Minimum run of EXACT-ZERO samples that separates events (CDP-enforced '(0.045351 to 10000.000000)' at 44.1 kHz). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 1 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.').

evening.description: With meter 0: 0 = no effect, 1 = drive event loudnesses to equal (CLIPS - see known_issues); intermediate = partial evening. With meter > 0: the level of UNACCENTED events relative to accented ones (0.3 = one-third level, verified exact on peaks). CDP-enforced '(0.000000 to 1.000000)' (Parameter[2]); breakpoint refused (parameter 2).

meter.description: Accent pattern: 0 = evening mode; N = every Nth event accented starting at event 1, others scaled to evening x accent level (verified exact at -m3). Source range 0-32767 (int slot). Breakpoint refused (parameter 3).

examples.description: Waltz accents on an even event stream.
examples.expected_use: Events 1,4,7,... keep their level; the rest drop to exactly 30% - attenuation only, clip-safe.

examples.description: Moderate level evening before granular processing.
examples.expected_use: Loudness differences reduced ~partially; follow with modify loudness gain < 1 if the source had very quiet events (boost path can exceed 0 dBFS).

known_issues: EVENING MODE CLIPS (first-class): meter 0 loudness-equalisation boosts quiet events with NO headroom management - verified peaks up to 6.45x full scale in the float output at evening 1 (3.28x at 0.5), no warning from CDP. The engine's float pipeline preserves the overs; attenuate downstream (modify loudness) or prefer the meter path, which only attenuates.

PREGAIN -p IS A NO-OP (first-class): -p0.1 and -p0.5 render byte-identical to flag-less. The banner usage line '[-mmeter] [-mpregain]' shows -m twice - the real flag is -p (source flag string "mp") and it does nothing in this mode; the entry omits it.
EVENT DETECTION = EXACT ZEROS (no threshold). No-silence material refuses 'ERROR: INVALID DATA / ERROR: NO SILENCE-GAPS FOUND IN FILE.'
Duration genuinely static (sample-exact, level-only edit); deterministic; stereo accepted (2.5 s 2-ch).
Accents start at event 1 and repeat every meter events (1, 1+N, 1+2N, ... verified at N=3).
